sentences.text:
Ms. Debadrita Mondal  
 Mr. Amanul Islam  Mr. Sourav Mukherjee

Dictated by Arijit Banerjee, J.
1.
The petitioner says that there is a serious love affair between him and the victim girl.
They propose to enter into matrimony.
The families of the petitioner and the victim girl are also supportive.
2. Learned State Counsel, while opposing the prayer for bail, says that the incident was heinous.
3. Be that as it may, the victim girl, who is represented through learned Advocate, supports the case of the petitioner.
4. In view of the aforesaid, we are inclined to enlarge the petitioner on interim bail.

5. Accordingly, we direct that the petitioner, namely, Nur Islam Sk @ Noor Islam Sk, shall be released on interim bail, upon Signed By :
TANMOY GHOSH High Court of Calcutta 10 th of January 2025 05:25:38 PM furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand), with two sureties of like Nur Islam Sk @ Noor Islam Sk vs Unknown on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116113199/
1 amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Judge,
Special Court (under POCSO Act), Berhampore, Murshidabad, subject to condition that the petitioner shall appear before the Trial Court on each and every date of substantive hearing subject to the provisions of Section 317 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and shall not intimidate the witnesses and/or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever and on further condition that the petitioner, while on interim bail, shall meet the Inspector-in- Charge/Officer-in-Charge of Nowda Police Station, once in a week, until further orders.
6.
